title: Tesla Plans Customer Robotaxi Fleet Additions
excerpt: Tesla stated during its third-quarter earnings call that customers may be able to add their vehicles to its robotaxi fleet next year.
body_html:
Tesla has set a timeline for allowing customers to include their own vehicles in the company's robotaxi fleet. During a third-quarter earnings call, Ashok Elluswamy, Tesla's vice president for autonomous driving, outlined the upcoming plan for the network.

For a long time, leadership has discussed the prospect of unsupervised autonomous driving and letting owners integrate their cars into a shared robotaxi system. With this recent announcement, the company has provided a specific target timeframe of next year for this capability to become available to vehicle owners.
